dedupe_keys.name: yaddum yet another dual doppler uncertainty model

description: Vasiljevic, Nikola and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The described model propagates uncertainty in dual-Doppler reconstruction of horizontal wind. Its named source-linked YADDUM v0.2.0 Python release supplies the implementation and explicitly refers to the underlying wind-lidar/radar measurement formulation. The code record belongs to the EU community, without native wind_energy membership, and is grouped as a supporting component. The primary presentation and code have different deposit terms. Wind-measurement uncertainty supports assessment of inflow evidence for wind-energy models; accuracy depends on the measurement geometry and assumptions. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-nc-nd-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
